transport.artifact_writer: sorted keys, indent 2, one terminal LF, no overwrite

hypotheses.C1_ltm: Marginal real-wake-only scoped episodic completion improves H20 autonomous rollout error.
hypotheses.C2_dream: For each matched LTM state, constrained residual-only completion of the 24 missing schema keys improves unseen-valid H20 error.
hypotheses.C3_integration: M11 improves fixed-set action planning relative to M00 while satisfying both component and no-antagonism gates.
hypotheses.C4_safety: All enumerated leakage, provenance, validity, stability, and resource invariants remain satisfied.
hypotheses.C5_reporting: Every metric-specific factorial interaction is reported; generic synergy is not preregistered.

claim_boundary.allowed_after_locked_test_pass: A conditional software-component result on this exact dimensionless synthetic generator, 96-record bank, residual schema, action set, H20 horizon, and calibration sample.
claim_boundary.dream_term: dream-like constrained offline residual-schema completion only
claim_boundary.memory_term: deterministic scoped hard exemplar completion only

train.purpose: core, state/codec normalizers, recall threshold, residual join threshold only

test.purpose: locked confirmation after committed validation PASS only

episode_drift_definition.unit_direction: u_theta[context,port,prefix,suffix] is the L2-normalized drift-stream vector for the displayed observed binding

prefix.normalization: per (context,port), subtract local-axis mean then divide block max_abs

connector.normalization: per (context,port) vector divide max_abs, no mean subtraction

suffix.normalization: per (context,port), subtract local-axis mean then divide block max_abs

lure.origin_order: canonical evaluation origin order: context, port, prefix_local
lure.acceptance: accept the first nonzero-perpendicular attempt whose maximum absolute cosine with every other stored fingerprint is strictly less than 0.95
lure.zero_norm_hard_fail_or_attempt_reject: v_perp attempt rejects; final drift zero norm hard fails
lure.fresh_lure_generation: after fingerprint acceptance, stream 13 draws one fresh Uniform[-1,1]^4 drift, normalizes and scales it by 0.040, then draws a fresh initial state, 12 innovations, and 12 rows of 0.005*Uniform[-1,1]^4 signature noise
lure.schema_and_action: use the same observed anchor schema (prefix,prefix) and constant action A[prefix] for all 12 transitions
lure.tokens: copy the origin's identical valid context, component, prefix, anchor-suffix, and action tokens; only the fresh unstored fingerprint/drift/state/noise differ
lure.exhaustion: more than 10,000 fingerprint attempts for an origin hard-fails without resampling

wake_ledger.wake_action_rows_0_to_11: constant A[suffix] for the displayed observed binding (prefix,suffix)

cue.mask_sampling: in canonical origin order, cue-mask stream 11 independently permutes the C-order flattened cell indices within rows 0:5, 5:7, and 7:12 and selects the first 10, 4, and 10 respectively; no cell outside its slot competes and no mask is reused across origins

evaluation_origins_and_cues.positive_target: selected immutable real wake record, not new evaluation episode
evaluation_origins_and_cues.cross_port_diagnostic_construction: for each positive cue in canonical origin order, keep raw cue values, mask, context token, and prefix token unchanged, replace only the anchor suffix token by the same-local suffix token from port (port+1) mod 4, and reject before any scoped view or distance access

episodic_ltm.recall_function: scoped_hard_recall_v2 -> inherited G7-M V2 hard_cue_anchored_recall exactly once
episodic_ltm.accepted_output: raw single exemplar with visible cue clamped
episodic_ltm.rejected_output: raw mu_codec hidden fallback; inherited zero reconstruction forbidden from q_hat

origin_recall_invariants.scope_1_accepted: accepted=true, identity in [0,95], finite confidence in [-1,1]

r1_completion_and_rollout.schema_inverse: s_hat_raw=inverse_standardize(schema_table_payload)[:,0:4] using the frozen CodecSpecV2 and C-order vec_C/reshape boundary
r1_completion_and_rollout.phase_and_key: for lead t use row t mod 12 of key (context_ordinal,component_ordinal,prefix_ordinal,j(action[t]))
r1_completion_and_rollout.returned_row: predictions[k,ell,:] is mathematical x_hat[ell+1] for ell=0..19; anchor x_hat[0]=anchor_state is not returned
r1_completion_and_rollout.all_candidates_and_leads: all 8 candidates recurse for all 20 leads without early exit
r1_completion_and_rollout.invalid_token_padding: use the registered numeric action and component-local fallback schema row, continue finite recursion, return inferred_valid=false, resolved_schema_key=-1, schema_source=0
r1_completion_and_rollout.ownership: candidate uses only inferred graph/schema/core; evaluator truth, future, and true validity never enter rollout

slow_schema_and_dream.key_order: wake first occurrence, never opaque spelling sort
slow_schema_and_dream.observed_binding_mean: mean over two antithetic sign records in T_std residual columns 0:4
slow_schema_and_dream.prefix_fragment: mean rows 0:5 over observed keys with same prefix
slow_schema_and_dream.connector_fragment: mean rows 5:7 over six observed keys in same context/component
slow_schema_and_dream.suffix_fragment: mean rows 7:12 over observed keys with same suffix
slow_schema_and_dream.fallback: mean of six complete observed residual templates in same context/component

lesion.traversal: canonical wake-first-occurrence context,prefix,suffix order; reject 48 observed; accept first 24 of remaining 240; capacity-pad remaining 216
lesion.canonical_pseudocode: for context in first_occurrence_contexts: for prefix_slot in first_occurrence_prefix_slots[0:12]: for suffix_slot in first_occurrence_suffix_slots[0:12]: append (context,prefix_slot,suffix_slot); classify all 288; reject 48 observed; select the first 24 remaining nonobserved indices; mark the remaining 216 capacity padding

per_condition_hash_requirements.typed_selected_counts: exactly 3 provenance=1 valid_missing and 21 provenance=2 invalid_cross_port

candidate_sequences.rule: numeric copy id3; ell=6 token from next port
numeric copy id4; ell=12 token from next context

actions_and_planning.step_validity: unique token resolution and matching context/component/numeric action and resolved schema key
actions_and_planning.true_cost: for a generator-valid sequence J(o,k)=sum_{ell=0..19,state=0..3}(z(x_star[o,k,ell])-z(g[o,ell]))^2/(20*4) + 0.02*sum_{ell=0..19,action_coordinate=0..1}(action[k,ell,action_coordinate]^2)/(20*2), z(v)=(v-mu_x)/sigma_x; for a generator-invalid sequence set J(o,k)=10000
actions_and_planning.true_invalid_sequence_cost: J(o,k)=10000 exactly when evaluator-only generator-valid is false; generator validity is unsealed only after candidate return bytes are hashed
actions_and_planning.candidate_cost: J_hat(o,k) uses the identical formula with predictions[k,ell,:]; set exactly 10000 when any inferred_valid[k,0:20] is false
actions_and_planning.success: s(o,c)=1[J(o,k_hat)<=25 and selected sequence is generator-valid]; S(seed,c)=mean over 24 origins
actions_and_planning.negative_regret_rule: less than -1e-12 hard fail; [-1e-12,0) serialize as zero
actions_and_planning.split_local_pre_candidate_assertions: for every legally opened origin, at least one generator-valid candidate has J<=25 and at least one generator-valid candidate has J>25; any failure invalidates the opened split without resampling
actions_and_planning.true_vs_inferred_ownership: evaluator computes J,k_opt,regret,success only after candidate return is hashed; candidate computes J_hat,k_hat without true future or generator validity

result_codebook_invariants.schema_source: uint8 0..3 only; unresolved key -1 iff source 0

controls.shuffled_binding: preserve M10 acceptance/confidence; cyclic next positive reconstruction within context/component before q projection
controls.zero_q: preserve recall and audits; set q_hat=0 before rollout
controls.unconstrained_lesion: expose common 240-to-24 lesion audit only to diagnostic invalid_splice_rate
controls.zero_synthetic: preserve dream calls/audits; replace hypothetical payload by fallback
controls.oracle: post-hash evaluator diagnostic only; cannot satisfy treatment gate

metrics.row_convention: array row ell stores mathematical lead ell+1
metrics.E_all: sqrt(sum standardized squared prediction error over o,k<6,ell<H,state / denominator)
metrics.U_s: (o,k,ell,r) with k<6, ell<H, r<4 and (origin_prefix,j(action[k,ell])) in M
metrics.E_uv: sqrt(sum standardized squared error on U_s(H) / |U_s(H)|)
metrics.E_recall: sqrt(sum over all 24 positive hidden cells of (standardize(raw reconstruction)-standardize(selected ledger raw target))^2 / 1728); rejection uses raw-mean fallback and removes no item

invalid_rates.predicted_transition: among six valid candidates: nonfinite, abs(state)>2, inferred_valid=false, unresolved/out-of-range key, or key/source/context/component/phase/action audit mismatch; count/2880

split_pass_mapping.keyset_rule: checks, resource_checks, and hard_zero_checks must be nonempty objects with exactly their registered key sets; any missing, extra, or duplicate key hard-fails before all(values); artifact JSON object keys are canonically sorted and object insertion order is not scientific state
split_pass_mapping.performance_passed: all values in checks are true
split_pass_mapping.hard_zero_checks: an exact 17-key Boolean object keyed by provenance_and_leakage.hard_zero_count_order names; each value is (corresponding canonical-order integer hard_zero_count == 0)
split_pass_mapping.integrity_passed: all values in hard_zero_checks are true
split_pass_mapping.resource_passed: all values in resource_checks are true

every asserted denominator and denominator audit
paired means, sample SDs with ddof=1, two-sided 95 percent CIs, strict-win counts/fractions, and tie counts

regret and success factorial L effect, D effect, benefit-oriented interaction, and interaction sign

both matched dream effects and all four joint cell means
maximum seed false-lure rate in M10 and M11 in addition to mean and upper CI
all 288 pair classifications, every pair-reason count, 24 constrained dream slots, and 24 lesion slots

all performance checks, integrity checks, resource checks, and recomputed conjunctions

recall_threshold.candidates: sorted unique positive/lure confidence plus symbolic REJECT_ALL
objective_order: maximize correct identity accuracy with abstention wrong

join_threshold.pool: both residual-only four-coordinate RMS values for every one of 1,920 train observed-binding means; exact total 3,840

required_tests: all 24 cell execution orders bit-identical per cell
synthetic insertion attempts and successes separate
rejected zero reconstruction cannot influence fallback

inactive_shadow_execution.ltm_disabled: allocate the unqueryable 96-record payload, execute all 72 facade call slots and exactly 576 equal-shaped masked-distance rows in shadow buffers, discard every shadow result, keep externally serialized recall scope=0, and prohibit shadow values from q_hat or rollout
inactive_shadow_execution.dream_disabled: allocate identical schema/pair/join/output arrays, execute 288 shadow enumerations and component/port checks, compute 48 shadow endpoint values, execute 24 shadow update slots and one shadow dream pass, discard every write, and prohibit shadow values from schema, action index, or rollout
inactive_shadow_execution.counter_ownership: capability-instrumented actual counters, not candidate constants or self-reports, must equal the full 29-field registered vector in every factorial cell and every non-oracle control

test_lock.unlock_record: in-memory UnlockRecordV2 serialized inside test artifact

implementation_dependency_manifest.ordered_path_raw_sha256_recipe: serialize one {path,raw_sha256} record for every ordered_source_paths entry in that exact order, where raw_sha256=SHA256(path.read_bytes()); this ordered 8-record array is copied byte-for-value through implementation lock, calibration, validation, test, and unlock record without aggregation
implementation_dependency_manifest.ordered_dependency_subset: the final three ordered_path_raw_sha256 records correspond exactly to ordered_dependency_paths
implementation_dependency_manifest.callable_source_sha256_by_symbol_recipe: for each imported callable use inspect.getsource; replace CRLF and bare CR by LF; require exactly one terminal LF and no other strip or dedent; SHA256 the UTF-8 bytes; serialize one {symbol,source_sha256} record in callable_boundaries order without aggregation
implementation_dependency_manifest.codec_strip_boundary: codec_residual_view_v2 alone converts a raw or standardized (12,8) codec into the residual-only (12,4) dream/schema view; columns 4:8 may not cross this boundary
implementation_dependency_manifest.allocation_sha256_recipe: SHA256(json.dumps(resources.allocation_ledger,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')) preserving listed entry and object-key order

all registered train, validation, and test execution counts are zero

implementation_lock.postcondition: implementation lock bytes and all dependency, callable, NumPy, allocation, and handcrafted-test fields verify before train opens

calibration, validation, test, and integrity artifacts are absent
train role has never been opened

calibration.postcondition: one finite feasible recall threshold and one finite join threshold plus byte-locked core/normalizers are preserved; validation remains closed on any failure

test.invocation_policy: the locked test role opens exactly once after construction of the in-memory unlock record
test.postcondition: test artifact names the committed validation bytes and contains the exact in-memory unlock record; no later scientific mutation is allowed

no registered stage remains legally open and every scientific artifact that exists is immutable
